prompt:
请作为熟悉NLP/ACL审稿的独立研究规划审查者，执行合并的 aris:novelty-check / research-refine（最多2轮）/ research-review；— composed: C:/Users/QVQ/Documents/ChatGPT/agent-research/CoReTA/refine-logs/acl2027-expert-transfer-20261029/ACL2027_RESEARCH_PLAN.md 。先读 PROBLEM_ANCHOR.md 和 round-0-initial-proposal.md（同目录），可检查其链接原材料和原文；只读，不编辑不跑实验不再委派。请自行审查命题，不沿用前序助手的乐观判断。用户标准：无需绝对原创；部分重合不是整项重复；也不能以未找到单篇覆盖全链就认定创新。研究“任务相关优势成员为什么在团队中不能发挥甚至被拖累，兼顾有益纠错”，人力1–2人每天8h以上、有导师，API/GPU和预算未知但由我们给预算；目标ACL2027最迟2027-01-04 23:59AoE。当前规划更偏分析＋关键干预，不预设新架构。用户要求聚焦可执行，不能不断叠限定把命题缩成特例。
新补充近邻 OSC: Cognitive Orchestration through Dynamic Knowledge Alignment in Multi-Agent LLM Collaboration, Findings EMNLP2025 .335，建模专家间knowledge gap并训练沟通对象/内容/表达策略，https://aclanthology.org/2025.findings-emnlp.335/ 。初稿内已有SAT §5、When Debate Helps、PBT、ICR、When Order Matters、Listening Agents、EDGE等直接先例。
独立输出：1明确建议及置信、2前三拒稿原因、3即使预期全成立是否值得ACL及具体差哪一发现、4主张→最小证据，5最小可执行干预和辨别力（包括反事实编辑信息变化、多环节非可加、局部效应非总体原因）、6样本量/预算/截止风险、7需要删除或改写条目。按research-refine七轴给可解释评分及weighted overall（fidelity15%,design specificity25%,contribution25%,frontier fit15%,feasibility10%,validation5%,venue readiness5%），CALIBRATION none，研究设计替代强行方法/训练细节；不要为得9分而虚增。记录review_independence:same-family，acceptance_status:provisional。我们是研究前内部模拟审核，不是实际ARR审稿，不生成接收概率。请输出完整中文审查结果，约1500–2500字。
=== NOVELTY VERDICT LIMITS (these bound how you judge, never how widely you search) ===
Search exhaustively; judge calibrated. Two failures waste months equally:
passing an idea a published paper already contains, and killing a viable idea
because the territory has neighbors.
1. Proximity is information, not a verdict. Someone working nearby goes in the
   report; it is not by itself a reason to reject.
2. ABANDON has exactly one qualification: a specific published paper already
   contains this result — name that paper. No named paper, no ABANDON.
3. Crowded-but-deltaed is PROCEED: state the delta in one sentence a reviewer
   could verify. Thin or contested delta is PROCEED WITH CAUTION — say what
   would make it carry, not why it should die. CAUTION is not a safe middle:
   if you cannot name the specific thing that makes the delta thin, the
   verdict is PROCEED.
4. Concurrent or competing work is not a veto. That is a race — report it and
   let the user decide whether to run it.
5. A direct attack on a central problem is legitimate novelty when nobody has
   executed it well. "This area is hot" does not mean "this area is taken."
6. This check is an early gate, never the last one — more triage, pilots, or
   external review still stand between any idea and a paper, whatever order
   this run uses. A wrongly passed idea dies cheaply at one of them; a wrongly
   killed idea is never seen again. When torn between two verdicts, choose the
   more permissive one.
Say plainly when an idea clears the check. Do not manufacture overlap.
midturn_steering_message: 已根据初步意见准备实质修订：C1不再是“相似终分不同机制”，改为“从干预前可见过程证据能否在留出题/新团队预测两种简单干预的相对效果，改善相对开发集固定最佳干预的效益”，统一标签/复议/额外token皆强对照；2种干预倾向独立依据复议 vs 保留初始候选供同读出选择，明确各自是操作包effect非纯阶段根因。只选1–2预设可观测特征，无gold/终局/反事实oracle作为选择输入；无法验证则保留负结果而不称已发现机制。内容保持重表达降为可选，小样本不强称因果mediator。样本已算q=.3时N240 MDE~9.9pp、600~6.3pp，不把240当小增益确认；建议API完整资金预留人民币1–1.5万，A先500以内仅规划。请判断这种聚焦是否比初稿实质更强，且是否有更简单正确的核心结果，不必因为我们提出而认可。
